report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Python BackEnd Developer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show the following required points:
- 5 years of software development experience
- 2 years of experience developing big systems with Python
- Experience with asynchronous programming and performance-critical applications

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
